development_result.status: safe-gate RD revalidation retained improvement in all five development folds

gate_stress_result.finding: mean-only source validation admitted a fold-unstable residual correction, including a 30.7% FRL RMSE deterioration
gate_stress_result.response: require unanimous source-validation cultivar improvement, prohibit any source-validation cultivar degradation, and cap the residual correction at one-half amplitude without changing the encoder or loss profiles
gate_stress_result.safe_gate_result: FRL reverted exactly to PLSR; five-fold AF pooled RMSE differed from PLSR by -0.066%, classified as safeguarded parity
gate_stress_result.confirmation_boundary: AF and RD are development/stress endpoints; the remaining seven endpoints are confirmation targets

confirmation_policy: After the AF gate stress test, the encoder, losses and fold-consensus gate are frozen. RD and AF are reported as development/stress endpoints; F6, LS, LW, MFF, PFD, PRW and SRF are confirmation targets.
